text:
incidents-bot: ALERT: notify-bridge outgoing webhook failures -> pagerduty (5xx spike). automated detection triggered. count=94 in 5m :rotating_light:

jess: seeing it. PagerDuty not showing new incidents?

pd-bot: webhook POST /v1/events returned 400 - header too large - "x-correlation" truncated (example: 413 Payload Too Large)

omar: hm, just pushed the edge-proxy header-scrub patch 12:05. maybe it's trimming or collapsing multi-value headers. rolling back? :thinking_face:

nina: if PD webhooks are 4xx/5xx pages won't be created. can someone manually page oncall while we triage?

jess: manual page to SRE oncall now. calling phone too.

oncall-rotation: I got the manual page and am starting triage. got the trace id from incidents-bot?

incidents-bot: trace_id=ab12-ef34 logged on alert.

omar: quick test: try calling the notify-fallback endpoint (secondary notifier) which bypasses the proxy. here's the curl I used locally:

```
curl -X POST https://notify-fallback.internal/api/v1/push -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"pd_event": "test", "meta": {"source":"incidents-test"}}'
```

jess: did fallback succeed?

omar: yes, got 200 and PD created an incident. forwarding the PD incident id to SRE.

sre-bot: Temporary mitigation applied: routing=notify-fallback for service=notify-bridge (env var NOTIFY_ROUTE=fallback). will monitor for a few minutes. :white_check_mark:

nina: paging restored. thanks. can we capture the exact header that trips PD?

pd-bot: sample PD response body: `\{\"error\":\"Invalid header: X-Correlation-Stack length=4096\"\}`

omar: looks like our proxy concatenated multiple x-correlation headers into one long header after the patch. rolling back the header merge now.

oncall-rotation: confirmed I stopped getting paged duplicates and received the manual page. currently investigating customer impact.

jess: CS reports two customers saw delayed incident notifications for ~3-6 minutes. ticket created CS-3371. no data loss.

nina: opened an ops incident ticket and assigned postmortem. action items: 1) revert proxy header merge 2) add header length guard 3) add integration test for PD header limits 4) run DR drill to exercise fallback

omar: reverting now, will push a canary in a minute.

incidents-bot: mitigation timeline recorded. status=mitigated (routing fallback + proxy revert in progress).

jess: great — improv notes: add synthetic webhook test to alert pipeline and monitor 4xx rates separately.

sre-bot: follow-up checklist created: https://redwood.internal/ops/incidents/CS-3371 (placeholder) :memo:

nina: pinging infra to add header guard to the proxy config and to add small e2e with PD.

omar: rolled back patch at 1725002701, proxy returning 200 for PD webhook tests.

oncall-rotation: confirming pages are flowing again. I'll keep watch for 30m then hand back to rotation.

jess: thanks everyone. we'll draft a short customer comms note and include mitigation steps.

incidents-bot: NOTE: please include exact PD response snippet in postmortem. closing thread for live mitigation. :lock:
